note: skip navigation control -- renders the fixed operator control for jumping to page content
site logo link -- renders the operator's fixed Stack Overflow branding
top navigation links -- render the operator's fixed navigation vocabulary
top navigation button -- renders a fixed operator navigation control
search control -- renders the operator's fixed search interface
help control -- renders the operator-defined help navigation control
sign-up control -- renders the operator's fixed account-registration vocabulary
left navigation -- renders fixed site navigation, collectives controls, and operator promotional controls
tag-page action control -- renders a fixed operator action
tag-page action link -- renders a fixed operator action
question-list controls -- render the operator-defined sort and view vocabulary
question-list dropdown -- renders the operator-defined ordering control
filter-panel toggle -- renders the fixed operator control for opening refinements
pagination controls -- render the operator-defined page-navigation vocabulary
selected pagination control -- renders the operator-defined current-page indicator
ad-report control -- renders the operator's fixed control about an advertisement
feed control -- renders the operator-defined feed or subscription link
site footer -- renders the operator's fixed footer navigation, social links, consent control, and site metadata
